gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-carian: Every curve of Autour One flows in through a clear channel. Give Noto Sans Carian a slightly generous size, since its terminals stay apart like open scissor blades and its ascenders hug the x-height.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Expressive and bold, Autour One draws like a plotter pen. Noto Sans Chakma packs its lowercase up toward the caps, so nudge its size upward so the open, uncrowded mouths get room.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Autour One's strokes look drawn with a fixed pen, each round letter entered through a clear channel. Noto Sans Coptic, sans-serif, hums beneath, its middle zone dominating the line.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Autour One looks laser-cut, bold and expressive in a single stroke width. What stands out most is how Noto Sans Cuneiform opens its e and swells its lowercase like inflated glass beads.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-devanagar: Expressive Autour One draws a plain, unmodulated outline with no hairline shift. Beneath it, Noto Sans Devanagari, a sans-serif, settles into a compact skyline where capitals blend into lowercase.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Autour One looks bold and expressive, with no pointed-brush swell anywhere. Noto Sans Duployan does the quieter work, its wide-mouthed lowercase a and oversized counters carrying the running text.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Bold is Autour One, with no pressure swells where the eye slows. Autour One is built to shout; Noto Sans Elymaic, a sans-serif with open apertures, is built to be read for hours.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Noto Sans Ethiopic is tall and sturdy, with c terminals hanging far out. Autour One, shaped like bent glass tubing, takes the showpiece role while the sans-serif quietly carries the text beneath.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Modern and spacious, Noto Sans Gothic fills its lowercase with counters like drilled glass beads, under Autour One's single-stylus lines. Paragraphs of it would glide by without a snag.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-imperial-: Autour One looks cut from strips of equal width, with a clear channel leading into every round letter. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic, plain sans, takes the text with pincer-open c ends.
